scientific_integrity: The infinite claims use exact Dirichlet factorial moments, posterior beta concentration and a deterministic cutoff; finite exact arithmetic and numerical diagnostics are separately reproducible and not a proof of the limit.
scientific_limitations: Annealed triangular-array limit for strictly positive symmetric Dirichlet shape a_q/log q -> kappa in (0,infinity); neither quenched convergence, moments, nor uniform error bounds are asserted. Fixed-shape and deterministic-weight results are credited. Historical priority of the moving-shape marked extreme is not independently verified.
title: Logarithmic Dirichlet concentration: Gumbel coupon completion and terminal rarity
